content_html:
This is named Agency 1 because I’m sure there will be many more about it. This is a topic that rlly catches my attention. Firstly, because it’s hard for me to define it. Secondly, because it looks rlly powerful. Thirdly, because I can see it in my life.
My thought to write here is how shyness is a bottleneck to agency. In the same way laziness, procrastination and don’t believing in yourself ade, shyness is also one. And this is relevant because is the one I have to deal the most. It’s improving, but in the same way laziness don’t allow you to be intellectually agentic, shyness won’t allow to be socially agrntic. And that matters as fuck (rod example of being accepted into Duke).
This resembles one conclusion I know it has been a while: the most important thing I need to do is to reach the same level I have with consciousness, neuroticism and iq for people skills or whatever you wanna call it.
